cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

mechanism: A directs preservation of shared memories, yielding handling details to B while turning each contribution into evidence of A greater care.
confusable: Unlike simply organizing an archive, A compares emotional credit; borrowed authority concedes practical method so B continues the shared task.
comparison: Competition over preserving an album differs from negotiating unequal physical effort while carrying luggage.
seedUse: Use D91-a tickets/album/protective storage critically; remove none-versus-all tickets contradiction. S02 seeds contribute revised practical terms rather than repeated status language.
